errors.name: NegativeStockError
errors.description: Raised when a wine's stock quantity is attempted to be set below zero.

errors.name: InvalidPricingException
errors.description: Raised when a wine's selling price is not strictly greater than its cost price.

errors.name: DuplicateWineNameError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to add a wine with a name that already exists in the system.

errors.name: LocationOverCapacityException
errors.description: Raised when assigning a wine to a storage location that exceeds its maximum bottle capacity.

errors.name: WineNotAssignedToLocationError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to remove a wine from a storage location where it is not currently assigned.
